repo.name: 5x1 apps
repo.description: BEep for Jibo robots running 5x1, from apps.5x1.com. Includes BEep BETA, which gets every change first. These are the same signed APKs as the website's downloads.

apps.name: BEep
apps.summary: Find and control your Jibo on 5x1

en-US.description:
BEep finds the Jibo robots on your Wi-Fi and opens BEacon, Jibo's control panel, in the 5x1 look.

• Finds every Jibo on your Wi-Fi by itself, or connect by IP address
• BEacon: status, screen, music, photos, people, the Store and settings
• Convert a modded Jibo to 5x1 from your phone

BEep only talks to your robot on your own network, and has no analytics or ads.
en-US.whatsNew: First Android version: find Jibo on your Wi-Fi, BEacon, and Convert a Jibo to 5x1

en-US.description:
The newest BEep, published with every change before it reaches BEep. It installs next to BEep and may have bugs.

BEep finds the Jibo robots on your Wi-Fi and opens BEacon, Jibo's control panel, in the 5x1 look, and can convert a modded Jibo to 5x1.
